issue_records.title: Fix emitting comments followed by `\r\n`
issue_records.body_excerpt: Before this patch the `\r` character would be part of the comment and not the following NewlineWs (which would simply be a `\n`-style NewlineWs instead of a `\r\n` as one would expect).

traceability_evidence.commit_message:
Fix tokenization of emitting comments followed by `\r\n` (#455)

Before this patch the `\r` character would be part of the comment and
not the following NewlineWs (which would simply be a `\n`-style
NewlineWs instead of a `\r\n` as one would expect).
